summary: Additional spread pair tests completed. Tested SOL-ETH and SOL-BTC spreads against previous BTC-ETH. SOL-BTC achieved best Sharpe (0.57) - best result in the factory so far, outperforming even SMA on SOL (0.53). SOL-ETH generated no trades. Evidence score: 70/100.
key_lessons: SOL-BTC spread achieved best Sharpe (0.57) - highest in factory, better than any single-asset strategy
Spread pair selection matters significantly: SOL-BTC (0.57) >> BTC-ETH (0.12) > SOL-ETH (0.0)
SOL-ETH generated no trades - assets moved together without divergence, typical in strong trending markets
Higher volatility assets (SOL) create better spread opportunities when paired with lower volatility assets (BTC)
Best overall strategy in factory: SOL-BTC spread with Sharpe 0.57, return 1.6%, drawdown -0.49%

risk_notes: Short test period (48h per window, 6 windows) limits statistical significance
